in_marathi.name: Leelavathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Leelavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Leelavathi is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Playful Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Shiva's consort Parvati or Lakshmi. The name signifies the divine playfulness and joyous nature of these goddesses.
